transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this weekly sustainment review started. I need confirmed updates from each of you on the materials currently in the holding area before I can sign the disposition plan. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders awaiting disposition. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation reps — please go ahead and report your status on each category so I can record it in the review record.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the used oil: I confirmed this morning that we have exactly 18 drums of used oil accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file, but I should note it has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the vehicle batteries: I counted exactly 24 cases in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so the shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are documented in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I want to flag that this information has not yet been sent to logistics.
